backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor file with no logic, serving as a placeholder for the ICP backend.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (price calculator slider, hero heading, floating button animations, section background colors) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key implementation details for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Empty CSS file at the frontend root level.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, and a LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema listing Magical Service's coverage across Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar localities.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that assembles the full landing page by composing all section components (Header, Hero, Services, etc.) inside an I18nProvider, with FloatingContactButtons rendered globally.
frontend/src/components/chat/SupportChat: Empty file for the support chat widget component.
frontend/src/components/common/IconBadge: Reusable icon wrapper component supporting size and variant props, applying premium badge styling with icon-vibrate and icon-shine animation classes.
frontend/src/components/common/InlineIco: Minimal wrapper that renders a Lucide icon inline with icon-vibrate animation class applied.
frontend/src/components/common/LogoWithB: Displays the Magical Service logo image inside a styled backing container with sm/md/lg size variants.
frontend/src/components/floating/Floatin: Fixed-position WhatsApp and Call buttons with continuous vibrate, glow-pulse, and shimmer-sweep animations to draw user attention.
frontend/src/components/landing/Appointm: Appointment booking form section that collects name, phone, service, area, date, time, and notes, then opens a pre-filled WhatsApp booking URL on submission.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Displays a two-column grid of priority and other service areas in Ahmedabad with a WhatsApp CTA button, using scroll reveal animation and i18n translations.
frontend/src/components/landing/FAQSecti: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with 10 translated Q&A pairs and call/WhatsApp CTA buttons at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Site footer with brand info, star rating, social links, quick navigation links, services list, and contact details, using i18n and scroll reveal.
frontend/src/components/landing/GoogleRe: Displays a grid of six hardcoded 5-star Google-style customer reviews with a rating summary and a link to view more reviews.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Sticky responsive header with logo, desktop navigation links, language switcher (EN/HI/GU), Instagram and WhatsApp action buttons, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Full-width hero section with a top announcement banner, a before/after sofa cleaning image with overlay text, star rating, and call/WhatsApp booking CTAs.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhot: Renders a responsive photo gallery section showcasing cleaning service images (sofa, carpet, mattress, etc.) with scroll-reveal stagger animations and hover overlay effects.
frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceC: Displays a two-column section with a coverage image and a list of Ahmedabad service areas rendered as chip badges with checkmark icons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Renders a services section with four animated service cards (sofa, AC, carpet, mattress) and embeds the SofaPriceCalculator component in a sidebar column.
frontend/src/components/landing/SofaPric: An interactive price calculator widget that lets users select a cleaning service and adjust size via a range slider, then generates a pre-filled WhatsApp booking link with the estimated price.
frontend/src/components/landing/WhyChoos: Displays a 'Why Choose Us' section with six feature cards (eco, speed, quality, etc.) and a stats row showing customer counts, reviews, years of experience, and satisfaction rate.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and exposing login status flags to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: React hook that detects the user's `prefers-reduced-motion` media query preference and returns a boolean, updating reactively on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollReveal.ts: React hook that uses IntersectionObserver and the Web Animations API to trigger scroll-based reveal animations on a container element, with optional staggered child animations and reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides an i18n context with locale state (en/hi/gu), persisted to localStorage, and exposes a `useI18n` hook for consuming translations throughout the app.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines TypeScript types and translation string structures for all UI sections (header, hero, services, calculator, etc.) across supported locales.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Thin re-export hook that reads the I18nContext and throws if used outside the provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for the Royal Blue/Gold color palette, Tailwind base/component/utility layers, font imports, section background utilities, and keyframe animations like vibrate.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappBooking.ts: Utility functions that format appointment booking details into a WhatsApp-ready message string and generate a pre-filled `wa.me` URL.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with CSS-variable-based colors, custom box shadows, border radii, font families, and accordion keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking existing implemented features and pending feature requests for the Ahmedabad sofa cleaning service website, including calculator updates, animations, and UI styling changes.
